Item 1.01 Entry into a Material Definitive Agreement

On June 18, 2026, CoreWeave, Inc. completed its previously announced private offering of $1,250 million in aggregate principal amount of its dollar-denominated 9.625% Senior Notes due 2032 and EUR 2,000 million in aggregate principal amount of its euro-denominated 8.500% Senior Notes due 2032.

Use of Proceeds

CoreWeave intends to use the proceeds from the offering of the Senior Notes for general corporate purposes, including repayment of outstanding indebtedness, and to pay fees, costs and expenses in connection with the offering.

Interest and Maturity

The Senior Notes will mature on July 15, 2032. The dollar-denominated notes will bear interest at a rate of 9.625% per annum, and the euro-denominated notes will bear interest at a rate of 8.500% per annum, payable semi-annually in cash in arrears.
